map.波动系数 CV 和标准差有什么区别？: What is the difference between CV and std dev?
map.标准差是绝对波动幅度，受价格量纲影响；CV 是相对波动（标准差/均值），便于不同: Std dev is the absolute fluctuation magnitude, affected by the price scale; CV is relative fluctuation (std dev / mean), convenient for horizontal comparison across series at different price levels. The higher the price, the smaller the CV for the same std dev, so the fluctuation looks smoother.
map.预警触发后一定不能采购吗？: Once an alert triggers, must we stop procurement?
map.不一定。预警仅提示短期偏离超过阈值，应结合供需趋势、库存与资金综合判断；持续触发: Not necessarily. The alert only signals short-term deviation beyond the threshold; judge with supply/demand trend, inventory and capital together. Persistent triggering may mean the price center has shifted up, so locking price opportunistically may be the right move.
